first_step_test: One tilted circular lens with a double rim establishes the size and fixed position; a beginner can copy it before any interior detail.

source.notes: Contact sheet generated for this current lesson; rejected iterations, if any, remain private.

final_elements.name: lens outer circle
final_elements.description: One slightly tilted large circle centered above the page middle.

final_elements.name: lens inner rim
final_elements.description: A second circle just inside the first, concentric and open to paper.

final_elements.name: handle
final_elements.description: One narrow handle starts at the lower-right rim and points to the lower right; its joint stays fixed.

final_elements.name: leaf outline
final_elements.description: One pointed oval leaf sits inside the lens, angled from upper left to lower right.

final_elements.name: leaf center vein
final_elements.description: A vein follows the long axis of the leaf without crossing its outline.

final_elements.name: leaf side veins
final_elements.description: Exactly four short side veins branch from the center vein, two on either side.

final_elements.name: glass glint
final_elements.description: One narrow unfilled curved highlight sits inside the upper-left rim.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: A light broken shadow sits directly below the handle tip.

frames.visible_job: Draw one slightly tilted circle above the middle of your page, then run a second circle just inside it to make a narrow metal rim.
frames.instruction: Draw one slightly tilted circle above the middle of your page, then run a second circle just inside it to make a narrow metal rim.

frames.visible_job: At the lower-right edge of the rim, draw two parallel strokes diagonally down-right and round their far ends into a grip. Keep the ring intact at the joint.
frames.instruction: At the lower-right edge of the rim, draw two parallel strokes diagonally down-right and round their far ends into a grip. Keep the ring intact at the joint.

frames.step_name: Set the leaf and center vein
frames.visible_job: Inside the glass opening, draw a pointed oval leaf angled from upper left toward the lower-right rim. Add its long center vein and short stem, stopping the stem at the inner edge.
frames.instruction: Inside the glass opening, draw a pointed oval leaf angled from upper left toward the lower-right rim. Add its long center vein and short stem, stopping the stem at the inner edge.

frames.visible_job: From the existing center vein, branch exactly four short curved veins, two on each side. Stop each short of the leaf edge and leave the rim and handle untouched.
frames.instruction: From the existing center vein, branch exactly four short curved veins, two on each side. Stop each short of the leaf edge and leave the rim and handle untouched.

frames.visible_job: Place one narrow, unfilled curved glass glint inside the upper-left rim, ending close to the leaf tip. Lay a broken graphite shadow just under the handle tip; keep the leaf and rim contours in place.
frames.instruction: Place one narrow, unfilled curved glass glint inside the upper-left rim, ending close to the leaf tip. Lay a broken graphite shadow just under the handle tip; keep the leaf and rim contours in place.

final_step.visible_job: Shade established rim and handle in warm gray, leaf in muted green, and deepen its four veins and existing shadow.
final_step.instruction: Shade the rim and handle lightly with warm gray pencil. Glaze the leaf muted green around its existing vein lines, preserve the glass glint as paper, and deepen the established shadow without adding contours.
adds: warm-gray and green shading on established contours
